dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent 2D narrowing from the wide mid-section toward a sharp posterior point, with the terminal end partially obscured by surface water turbulence.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized asymmetrical protrusion on the left lateral margin near the mid-section relative to the more uniform right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-mid grey tone with lavender-blue chromatic qualities; distinctively darker than the mature white phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency darker grey shading distributed along the central dorsal axis and posterior to the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the primary light-grey base and darker pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, high-contrast dark mark on the left lateral edge at the mid-body level.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Sharp, linear longitudinal ridge along the posterior dorsal midline creating a distinct structural fold.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct pale circular patch on the left lateral margin consistent with localized epidermal depigmentation.
